contexts.text: He becomes at first as it were half-dead.
They are sent into Hell, where they lie... as it were half-dead... for from ten... to two thousand years. SE 5496. SE 5499. SE 5984. SE 6016. SE 6028.
To be half-dead () = when he was almost destitute of spiritual life.

(The infernals) live as half-dead. Life with them is from their being able to think, will, etc... which is only a faculty originating from the life which is God, acting from without into them according to order, and continually urging to order... and the deadness with them is from the evils and falsities originating from their loves. Hence it is that their life, regarded from their loves, is not life, but death; and therefore Hell, in the Word, is called death. and those who are there are called dead.
